# PhotoRoom

PhotoRoom provides AI-powered APIs for removing backgrounds, editing and resizing product photos, generating images from prompts, and checking account credit usage.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/photoroom/.

## Actions

- **Edit Image**: Apply one or more combined PhotoRoom v2 edits to an image URL or uploaded file.
- **Generate Image**: Generate a new image from a text prompt with PhotoRoom v2.
- **Get Account Usage** (read-only): Return the connected live PhotoRoom account's reported plan and remaining image credits.
- **Remove Background**: Remove the background from one uploaded image with PhotoRoom's dedicated Basic API.
